title: Birthday Parties
seoDescription: Host birthday parties at Cococabana in Oceanside with rooftop cocktails, food, and coastal views.
heroText: Celebrate birthdays on the rooftop in Oceanside.

heroImage.alt: Coco Cabana rooftop packed with guests at golden hour — full venue energy for a birthday celebration

sections.title: Built for Your Night
features: Cabana lounge seating and bar top seating
Four stories above the Pacific coastline
text: Call us or fill out the inquiry form below to talk through your date, group size, and what you're envisioning. Every birthday is different — we'll make it work.
sections.imageAlt: Group celebrating on Coco Cabana rooftop with cocktails and the gold pineapple wall

sections.title:
The Rooftop
Is Yours
text: Four stories above 408 Pier View Way — open air, full bar, and a view that turns any birthday into an event worth remembering. DJ nights every Friday and Saturday make it that much better.
sections.imageAlt: DJ facing the crowd at Coco Cabana rooftop — palms, open sky, packed venue

sections.title: A Setting That Does the Work
text:
Palm trees, cabana seating, signature lighting, and the Pacific coastline — the rooftop at Coco Cabana handles the ambiance so your crew can just enjoy the night.

Whether you want a low-key dinner setting or a full rooftop takeover with a DJ, we can put together something that works for your group. Just reach out and we'll talk through the options.
sections.imageAlt: Coco Cabana rooftop lounge with pink daybeds, tile wall, and Oceanside city views at dusk

steps.title: Inquire Below
steps.text: Fill out the inquiry form with your event date, party size, and any details. Or call us directly at (858) 304-7725.

steps.title: We Build the Plan
steps.text: We'll follow up within 1 business day to confirm availability and put together the details for your night.

steps.title: Enjoy the Rooftop
steps.text: Show up, settle in, and let the rooftop do the rest. We'll handle everything so you can focus on the birthday.
